description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing Git's checkout functionality, specifically focusing on operations that cause a detached HEAD state, warning messages, and output formatting behaviors.

methods.name: check_detached
methods.description: Checks whether the repository is in a detached HEAD state.

methods.name: check_not_detached
methods.description: Checks whether the repository is not in a detached HEAD state.

methods.name: check_orphan_warning
methods.description: Verifies if a warning about orphaned commits is present in the output.

methods.name: check_no_orphan_warning
methods.description: Verifies that no orphan warning is present in the output.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the repository to the main branch and verifies it is not detached.
